title: Analytics API queries
lead: Use the Dashboard for routine inspection. The local aggregate panel and server-side Query API support custom analysis or external integrations. The public Pages app does not host an aggregate-query server.

items: Start the local Web development server and configure the server-side Analytics license and API key. Use the same Analytics license whose collected data you want to inspect.
Open Bitmovin Analytics (server-proxied query). Choose Impressions, Avg startup time, Avg video startup or Avg buffered (rebuffer).
Wait for Querying… to finish. The status shows the selected preset and row count; the result below shows row values. Time values are raw milliseconds.
Each click requests the last 7 days at that moment, as one aggregate. The GUI has no date picker, category selector, chart or free-form query editor.

rows: Allows player usage for an authorized host/app
Player configuration; it is not the Query API secret.
Selects the collector destination and queried dataset
Server-only BITMOVIN_ANALYTICS_API_KEY, or the BITMOVIN_API_KEY fallback.
Selects an authorized organization for the API key

blocks.text: Replace placeholders only in your local/server configuration and restart the development server. Never place an account API key in a VITE_* variable, Player Config, source URL or copied client code. Static Pages has no server that can hold this secret.
Read the result and JSON response

The GUI displays rows, not a JSON editor. The existing /api/analytics/query endpoint returns the row array and row count plus the requested aggregation and dimension. This invented example means one result row containing the count 42; rowCount is not the impression count.

With no interval or groupBy, a count normally occupies one value in a row. Empty rows produce (no rows) in the GUI. A successful request alone does not prove that the intended source, license, period or filters matched data.

From a trusted terminal, you can call the existing local proxy with an explicit UTC range. Use the port printed by your development server; 5173 is the example below. The proxy supplies the server-selected license and API secret, so neither appears in this request.
Use the Query API for a breakdown

The following direct API example averages positive video startup times by browser and hour. Save the body as query.json, replace the Analytics license placeholder, and choose dates inside your data retention window. This is a server/terminal example, not a new GUI feature.

blocks.title: Send from your server or trusted terminal

blocks.text: Use an authorized server environment for BITMOVIN_API_KEY. Add X-Tenant-Org-Id only when the API key requires an organization scope. Direct API responses wrap results in data.result and can include columnLabels/contextDescription; read those labels before assigning meanings to columns. The app proxy keeps rows and rowCount but does not forward every response field or every Query API option.
Keep the same population when comparing

items: start and end choose an explicit time window. Use UTC timestamps and data within your retention period; the local GUI presets choose the last 7 days automatically.
interval groups time into MINUTE, HOUR, DAY or MONTH buckets. It is different from the overall start/end range.
groupBy chooses categories, for example BROWSER, COUNTRY, DEVICE_TYPE or OPERATINGSYSTEM. filters selects the subset, for example BROWSER EQ Chrome or VIDEO_STARTUPTIME GT 0.
Keep the Analytics license, range, timezone, filters, aggregation, unit and collector coverage with any exported result. Do not assume that every collector reports every dimension.

blocks.text: If a query does not return the expected value

rows: The server lacks an Analytics license or API secret. Configure the server, rather than entering a secret in the browser.
Check JSON syntax, aggregation, dimension and ISO-8601 start/end fields.
Check the server API key's permissions and organization scope; a Player license cannot authenticate this API.
Check that the development backend can reach the upstream API. A static build alone has no proxy.
Check the selected Analytics license, collected data, range and filters before interpreting it as a zero result.
